# Local Chart.js distribution

Chart.js 4.5.1, MIT license. Obtained from the official chart.js npm package:

- Metadata: https://registry.npmjs.org/chart.js/4.5.1
- Upstream: https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js
- API: https://www.chartjs.org/docs/latest/

The downloaded tarball was verified against its npm SHA-512 integrity before
copying `dist/chart.umd.min.js`, its source map, and `LICENSE.md`. No npm install
or frontend build is required. All chart assets are served from this app's
static directory, with no runtime CDN request.
